Do you sometimes wish your phone’s volume controls were easier to manage? With Volume Control Sound Launcher, you can instantly boost every sound on your device. Easily adjust Media Volume for music and videos, turn up Ringtone Volume so you never miss a call, and boost Alarm Volume to wake up on time. You can also Increase Notifications for important alerts and manage System Volume for maximum clarity across all app sounds.

Please note: As a launcher app, the layout of your home screen may change after install. Don’t worry, all your apps are still on your phone – they just may be in a different location. To learn more, please visit our FAQ section: https://phonevolumecontrol.com/#faq

With a launcher app, you get the added benefits of:

🚀 One-swipe access
Quickly adjust your device’s volume with just one swipe from your home screen!

📱 Home screen widget
See the time, weather, and more, conveniently on your home screen with our customized widget.

🖼️ Wallpaper
Personalize your home or lock screen with a wide selection of beautiful themed wallpapers.

🔍 Multi-touchpoint search
Apps and web search has never been easier. Search for installed apps or the web (powered by Google or Yahoo!) from multiple access points.

With Volume Control Sound Launcher, every sound – from your favorite songs to morning alarms – feels just right. This launcher app gives you quick access to the tools you need for a smoother and more personalized sound experience.

This launcher app puts all your essential volume settings just one swipe away, making it easy to adjust volume, fine-tune your sound, and enjoy better control throughout the day. Whether you want a simple volume control, clearer calls, or more balanced media sound, everything is easier to manage in one place.

Whether you’re listening to music, watching videos, gaming, or taking calls, Volume Control Sound Launcher gives you fast access to sound settings and lets you make music louder for a balanced listening experience.

Here’s why you’ll love this free app:

🔊 Easily adjust volume for music, videos, calls, alarms, and notifications

🔊 Access and manage all system sounds from one central location

🔊Enjoy smart controls designed for daily comfort and audio clarity

Who is it suitable for?
This free app is ideal for anyone who values fast, convenient sound control: whether you're listening to music, taking calls, or setting alarms.

Download Volume Control Sound Launcher now and enjoy better control over your audio.

Please write to us should you have any queries or comments about the app, including recommendations for new features. Also, please note that you can uninstall it at any time.
